items.description: Best efficiency of small generators by rated power
Turbine efficiency against flow, from curves fitted to many manufacturers' data
items.note: Appendix A. Value: the cross-flow turbine's efficiency at design flow, e = 0.79 - 0.15 x - 1.37 x^14 with x = (Qd - Q)/Qd. Reaction runners: d = k Qd^0.473 (k 0.46 below 1.8 m, 0.41 above), specific speed nq = k h^-0.5 (k 800 Kaplan and propeller, 600 Francis). Francis: e_nq = ((nq - 56)/256)^2, e_d = (0.081 + e_nq)(1 - 0.789 d^-0.2), ep = 0.919 - e_nq + e_d - 0.0305 + 0.005 Rm (Rm default 4.5), Qp = 0.65 Qd nq^0.05, below Qp e = (1 - 1.25 ((Qp - Q)/Qp)^(3.94 - 0.0195 nq)) ep, full-load drop 0.0072 nq^0.4, above Qp e = ep - ((Q - Qp)/(Qd - Qp))^2 (ep - er). Kaplan and propeller: e_nq = ((nq - 170)/700)^2, e_d = (0.095 + e_nq)(1 - 0.789 d^-0.2), ep = 0.905 - e_nq + e_d - 0.0305 + 0.005 Rm; Kaplan Qp = 0.75 Qd, e = (1 - 3.5 ((Qp - Q)/Qp)^6) ep; propeller Qp = Qd, e = (1 - 1.25 ((Qp - Q)/Qp)^1.13) ep. Pelton with j jets: n = 31 (h / (Qd / j))^0.5 (the flow per jet divides the head; this reading gives ESHA's worked example of about 1,000 rpm at 400 m and 0.42 m3/s), d = 49.4 h^0.5 j^0.02 / n, ep = 0.864 d^0.04, Qp = (0.662 + 0.001 j) Qd, e = (1 - (1.31 + 0.025 j) |(Qp - Q)/Qp|^(5.6 + 0.4 j)) ep. Plant power P = rho g Q (Hg - h_hydr) e_t e_g (1 - l_trans)(1 - l_para), hydraulic loss h_hydr = Hg l_max (Q / Qdes)^2.

items.description: Share of the time the firm flow is available on the flow-duration curve
Base flow left in a river, as a fraction of its average annual flow, by habitat outcome
items.note: 10% of the average flow is the minimum for short-term survival of most aquatic life; 30% sustains good survival habitat for most aquatic life forms.

items.description: Absolute roughness of commercial pipe walls
items.note: Commercial steel 0.045-0.046 mm, PVC and drawn tubing 0.0015 mm. Darcy friction factor from Swamee & Jain (1976): f = 0.25 / (log10(eps / (3.7 D) + 5.74 / Re^0.9))^2, valid for 1e-6 < eps/D < 1e-2 and 5000 < Re < 1e8.
